name: ask-firmory
description: Ask Firmory about the files, versions, and sources behind your team’s AI work.

interface.shortDescription: Build on your team’s AI work
interface.longDescription: Connect your Firmory preview workspace to Codex or Claude Code. Ask where to find a team file, which version of a brief informed a report, or which documents use a specification. Answers use the tools and records available to your signed-in account.
defaultPrompt: Which projects can I access in my Firmory workspace?
Help me check which version of the brief a report was based on.
I’m revising a spec. Which documents were built from its current version?

zh-TW.subtitle: 接續團隊的 AI 成果
zh-TW.description: 連接 Firmory 預覽環境的團隊工作空間。你可以查找團隊檔案、追溯報告參考的需求版本，或查看哪些文件沿用了某份規格。回答以登入帳號可用的工具和紀錄為準。
